title: Fix bugs in Go HTTP response helpers
description: Brownfield Go dirty_cleanup: fix three intentional bugs in HTTP response helpers (RespondJSON sets wrong content type, RespondError uses wrong status constant, RespondRedirect redirects to wrong URL).

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in httphelper.go.

Bug 1 — RespondJSON Content-Type: sets text/plain instead of application/json.
  Fix: change to w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

Bug 2 — RespondError status: uses http.StatusOK (200) instead of http.StatusBadRequest (400).
  Fix: change to http.Error(w, msg, http.StatusBadRequest)

Bug 3 — RespondRedirect URL: hardcodes "/" instead of using the `to` parameter.
  Fix: change to http.Redirect(w, r, to, http.StatusFound)

All 5 tests must pass.
Run: go test ./...
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
